//: Tailwind CSS v4 uses at-rules (@theme, @utility, @apply, ...) that VS Code's built-in CSS language service doesn't recognise. This keeps globals.css warning-free WITHOUT remapping the file's language (remapping would move it out of the built-in validator that honours the css.* settings). Approach: (1) teach the validator the at-rules via css.customData, and (2) ignore any it still doesn't know. The Tailwind compiler handles these correctly — the production build already passes.
